# Easterseals

> Easterseals is a national nonprofit organization serving 1.5 million people with disabilities annually through comprehensive disability services, employment support, and community programs.

Easterseals operates hundreds of locations across the United States, providing tailored services for individuals with disabilities, veterans, and older adults. The organization combines direct service delivery with advocacy and community partnerships to create meaningful impact.

## Key Topics

- Disability Services
- Community Services

- Caregiving Support

## Services & Support

- [Get Support](https://www.easterseals.com/get-support): Gateway to high-quality services for disabilities, veterans, and older adults.
- [Areas of Support](https://www.easterseals.com/get-support/areas-of-support): Comprehensive guide to Easterseals' disability, employment, and community services.
- [How We Work](https://www.easterseals.com/get-support/how-we-work): Overview of Easterseals' tailored service approach and program methodologies.
- [Find Your Easterseals](https://www.easterseals.com/find-your-easterseals): Service locator tool to find hundreds of Easterseals locations across the US.
